finding_resolution.reason: D1 correctly narrows to a proposed zero-amplitude tangent with an explicit smoothing rule; finite-small-scale ensemble response is not claimed.
D2 explicitly stipulates H-A9 seed-indexed accounting; material-domain extension is unproved and W09 void/region ratios exceed one.
The volume-share identity and compression versus threshold-only k=0 responses are correct.
H15 is correctly restricted to constant shares and the step counterexample is correct; an integrated RMS deviation is still presented as a pointwise or two-window accuracy bound.
The signed Gaussian qualification/mechanism is repaired; the added nonnegative pair fails the claimed common unconditional wall-density covariance constraint.
Direct/post-hoc/PBS-reclosure variants are computed and distinguished correctly; section 8 still claims a transfer-only correction.
Cap fractions and wall-density-freedom conclusion are repaired; section 8 still declares the full S1 necessary.
W09 extrapolation and median heuristic status are present; median summary values in README/CLAUDE omit the epsilon-threshold/no-controlled-error qualifier.
All 19 original invalid probes reject; five additional input versus value or convergence provenance inconsistencies are accepted.
Panel/refinement implementation passes 99 independent two-threshold cases; 20 historical cases return accurately and one refuses at the 1024 cap.
The four-decimal input-plus-output rounding budget is algebraically correct and references pass; full-precision accuracy is not thereby established.
EH98 no-wiggle terminology and baryon-shape suppression match Eqs. 26, 28–31 of the unchanged provider.
All four display corrections, seven source hashes and proper-radius clarification check.
All 16 successor entries and source hashes/positions check; ref creation and fast-forward are separately described.

findings.consequence: The added construction does not prove nonuniqueness while holding all stated constraints fixed; its computed positive-density examples remain valid under weaker constraints.
findings.statement: Conditional wall-mass normalization is different in the two laws and rescales their unconditional wall-density covariance. Matching the latent Gaussian field is not matching the declared density field.
findings.suggested_resolution: Declare exactly whether the fixed spectrum is the pre-normalization carrier, the contrast normalized to its unconditional mean, or the conditionally normalized wall density. Narrow the proof to the first if intended, or construct laws with the actually declared density covariance held fixed. Remove the stronger conclusion until that is demonstrated; report both normalizers and the free smoothing/calibration choices.
findings.title: Nonnegative laws do not share the declared unconditional wall-density covariance

findings.consequence: An accepted strict-JSON output can assert sigma=.649389 for a spectrum whose factory result is 1.298779, or a converged 33/17-node result whose factory refuses.
findings.statement: Public frozen records check internal algebra but do not bind every result/diagnostic to the declared spectrum, radius, seed radius or grid. target_premise_rms is only checked for finiteness and positivity.
findings.suggested_resolution: Bind results to the full input/provenance tuple using recomputation or a sealed validated factory record. Recompute the target premise result, validate grid metadata, and add replacement tests for each accepted case. Do not describe algebra-only checks as complete input-integral validation.
findings.title: Records can retain numerical results after changing their scientific inputs

findings.consequence: The current report contradicts its corrected sections and the resolution register overstates complete resolution.
findings.statement: Section 8 still says the anchor corrects the transfer function only, correlated-law effects are double counting, and the full S1 is required. These are not explicitly superseded quotations.
findings.suggested_resolution: Update or expressly supersede the current self-audit: empirical normalization at fixed closure; masked-wall/cross-covariance mechanism; wall-density freedom does not select full S1. After correcting DF1/DF2, update the resolution counts to independently verified outcomes.
findings.title: Current self-audit retains claims retired by the remediation

findings.consequence: The asserted 0.12% interval-placement accuracy for near-constant PBS kernels is not derived, though constant-share H15 and the step counterexample are correct.
findings.statement: G_eff/G(0)-1 is a weighted scalar statistic. It is not sup_k|G(k)/G(0)-1| over the noncompact top-hat support, and it does not bound both target and homogeneity windows.
findings.suggested_resolution: Call the quantity an integrated RMS deviation; remove the pointwise maximum and interval-placement guarantee or derive and verify a bound for both window integrals.
findings.title: Integrated RMS closeness is presented as a maximum propagator error bound

findings.consequence: Passing 35 tests/32 gates is limited evidence for complete record validation and error-budget coverage. Survivors are not all scientific failures.
findings.statement: Six mutants survive the unchanged 35 H tests or applicable gates; three reveal defensive-coverage omissions and removing the output half-unit budget passes all evidence.
findings.suggested_resolution: Add adversarial tests for growth-background consistency, interval target_inside, invalid-quadrature Frechet refusal and a rounding-budget boundary requiring the output term. Exercise actual evidence helpers. Treat centre-split removal with intact transition edges as a tested benign survivor and docstring-only sign reversal as documentation coverage.
findings.title: Tests do not exercise several new defensive invariants and the output rounding contribution

findings.consequence: Summary readers can infer more physical control than the detailed report establishes.
findings.statement: README and CLAUDE identify a heuristic median seed but omit that its epsilon lies below an adopted threshold without a controlled error estimate beside the quoted primary values.
findings.suggested_resolution: Put the epsilon-threshold and no-controlled-error qualifier beside the median headline values, retaining heuristic prior and the W09 formal-extrapolation qualifications.
findings.title: Median-seed summary qualifier is incompletely propagated
